mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) may increase simvastatin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism and increase myopathy risk through additive muscle toxicity and potential renal impairment affecting statin clearance.
action: Monitor for myopathy symptoms (muscle pain, weakness); consider simvastatin dose reduction or temporary discontinuation during aminoglycoside therapy; monitor renal function and creatine kinase if continued together.
